name: Colorado Western Slope 2020

venue.name: SpringHill Suites Grand Junction Downtown
venue.address: 236 Main Street, Grand Junction, Colorado 81501 USA

information:
# The competition is cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak.
* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* No outside food and drink.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:30 AM.
